cat about.md

I build intelligent systems.

I am a B.Tech student at Bhilai Institute of Technology, Raipur, with a strong passion for AI/ML, IoT, and building intelligent systems that bridge hardware and software.

I specialize in Computer Vision, NLP with BERT, and IoT embedded systems. From building fake news detectors to energy monitoring dashboards, I thrive on solving real-world problems with technology.

Whether it's training an ML model on Google Colab, interfacing sensors via Modbus RTU, or crafting a clean web dashboard — I love the intersection where AI meets hardware and software.

"My passion lies at the intersection of AI and IoT — where intelligent algorithms meet physical hardware. I believe the future belongs to those who can bridge both worlds."
// career objective

To become an AI/IoT engineer who builds intelligent systems that solve real-world problems — from smart energy monitoring to AI-powered content verification, continuously pushing the boundaries of what's possible.

01 2025
major ML project full-stack ML web app

Fake News Detector with Source Credibility Scoring

Real-time fake news classification using BERT (Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers) NLP model. Features a source credibility scoring system that evaluates news source reliability. Built with FastAPI Python backend and React + Vite frontend with a sleek glassmorphism UI. Model trained on Google Colab using T4 GPU for high-performance inference.

02 2024
professional · YVY Technologies iot + web

ESP32 Energy Monitoring Dashboard

IoT + Web Dashboard built professionally for YVY Technologies. Full-stack energy monitoring system using ESP32 microcontroller communicating with Secure Elite 440 energy meter via Modbus RTU serial communication protocol. Features live real-time energy graphs powered by Chart.js, with PDF & Excel export capabilities and YVY Technologies branded UI. Deployed and actively used at YVY Technologies.

Face Detection System

Computer Vision project using OpenCV Haar Cascade classifier. Detects human faces in real-time from webcam feed or images with high accuracy. The Haar Cascade model identifies facial features and draws bounding boxes around detected faces instantly.

Personalized Face Recognizer

Personalized face recognition system using OpenCV with LBPH (Local Binary Patterns Histograms) algorithm. Trains a custom model on specific faces and recognizes individuals personally — identifies who the person is by name. Supports custom face profile creation and training.
